candidates = cloudPricingData.filter(server => server.ram_gb >= ram_gb);\n\n            if (candidates.length === 0) {\n                // If no server has enough RAM, find the largest available\n                candidates = cloudPricingData.slice().sort((a, b) => b.ram_gb - a.ram_gb);\n            } else {\n                // Sort by RAM (ascending) to find the closest match\n
